title: Why Won't My Dryer Start? Common Causes and Fixes

seo.title: Why Won't My Dryer Start? Common Causes and Fixes
seo.meta_description: A dryer that will not start may have an unrecognized door, a setting that prevents starting, loss of power, a tripped breaker, or an open internal safety component.

content_html:
A dryer that will not start may have an unrecognized door, a setting that prevents starting, loss of power, a tripped breaker, or an open internal safety component. Start with external checks; do not perform live-voltage tests or bypass thermal or door switches.

Confirm the door, start control, and settings

Close the door until the latch engages and check child lock, delayed start, and cycle selection. Some models require holding Start for several seconds; use the manual before assuming a fault.

Check power from outside the appliance

Make sure the plug is secure and the circuit has not tripped. High-power electric dryers may use a double-pole breaker; reset it only once from fully off and do not keep resetting it if it trips again.

A door that does not engage the switch can prevent starting

If the door will not latch, the striker is broken, or the appliance does not detect closure, clean the area and inspect visible parts. Do not hold or bypass the door switch to make the dryer run.

A thermal fuse or internal fault requires fixing the cause

A thermal fuse can open after overheating from poor airflow or another fault. Replacing it without checking the vent, lint filter, and overheating cause can lead to another failure; internal diagnosis belongs to service work with power isolated.

faq.question: Which settings can keep a dryer from starting?
faq.answer: Close the door until the latch engages and check child lock, delayed start, and cycle selection. Some models require holding Start for several seconds; use the manual before assuming a fault.

faq.question: How many times should a tripped dryer breaker be reset?
faq.answer: Make sure the plug is secure and the circuit has not tripped. High-power electric dryers may use a double-pole breaker; reset it only once from fully off and do not keep resetting it if it trips again.

faq.question: Why shouldn't a dryer door switch be bypassed?
faq.answer: If the door will not latch, the striker is broken, or the appliance does not detect closure, clean the area and inspect visible parts. Do not hold or bypass the door switch to make the dryer run.
